setup.method: Actual desktop components rendered with the application mock server and sample API responses in an isolated temporary copy.

workflowTour.method: Actual desktop components rendered with the application mock server and sample API responses in an isolated temporary copy. Ship form filled without submitting.

walkthroughs.method: Actual desktop components in an isolated temporary copy. Stateful sample API responses show each setup stage. No live infrastructure or provider credentials used. External sign-in approval simulated; task composer not submitted.

tutorialEntryScreens.method: Full desktop screenshots from the same isolated app and mock API as the walkthroughs. Fallback has a documentation-only SVG arrow captured over the actual control. Administration entry screens show the desktop link to the web administration site, not an editable desktop administration UI.

detailedTutorials.method: Actual desktop components rendered with sample API responses in an isolated temporary copy. Artifact and preview annotation screenshots use the actual picker script and a sample checkout page. Native app update availability is simulated for browser capture; no update is installed. Boxes and arrows are SVG overlays positioned at the actual controls before browser capture.
